structural_subtarget.name: PAIR_LEVEL_ORPHAN_COVERAGE_LEMMA
idea: Collapse each frozen adjacent block pair (G_{2q-1},G_{2q}) to one pair position.
An unresolved odd selector occupies one pair position.
An orphan payload occupies at least two and at most three pair positions, with two projected odd-support positions and two unresolved-even supports.
Separate the common Shannon backbone from pair-level/local cone contributions.
Prove the minimum unresolved-odd pair coverage is at least four gates smaller than every orphan payload cone.
